notes: Recognition + rating expansion layer. The 1,311 new-recognition models now carry full PN Score component breakdown (performance/capacity/quality/endurance -> overall_score) and suitability scores, calibrated against the 658 originally-scored NVMe rows and tagged with rating_confidence (ESTIMATED-HIGH/ESTIMATED-MEDIUM/ESTIMATED-LOW) plus rating_basis explaining the estimate. pn_tier is NOT stored here; it is computed at runtime by the app real storageGearTier()/STORAGE_TIER_THRESHOLDS from overall_score, identical to every other scored catalog entry (POOR/COMMON/UNCOMMON/RARE/EPIC/LEGENDARY/ARTIFACT). The source package labeled these with a Mass Effect tier scheme (HUSK..LEVIATHAN) that does not exist anywhere in the live PROFITNODE codebase; those labels were discarded on import rather than introducing a second, contradictory tier system. Aliases resolve free-text search/import strings (OEM part numbers, SMART model strings, prefix patterns) to a canonical brand+family(+capacity) match against the combined catalog (this file plus the existing 658 scored NVMe rows in profitnode_storage_catalog_v1.json). Ambiguous aliases (families field has >1 entry) intentionally return multiple candidate matches rather than auto-collapsing to one.
